meta.title: Festivales Náuticos MX
meta.description: Festivales Náuticos MX, an organization based in Los Cabos, Mexico, organizing nautical events like the Day of the Dead Boat Parade and the Christmas nautical festival 'Mar y Christmas'.

banner.headline: Experience the magic of the sea and Mexican tradition at Festivales Náuticos MX.

about.paragraph: Our festivals blend the majesty of the sea with Mexico's cultural richness, creating unforgettable experiences for visitors from around the world.

altares.title: Altares en el Mar 2025
altares.info: 'Altares en el Mar' is an immersive festival that honors our loved ones with floating offerings full of color and tradition.
altares.cta: Relive the most spectacular moments from last year's edition.

marxmas.title: Mar & Xmas 2025
marxmas.info: 'Mar & Xmas' celebrates the holiday season with a maritime parade full of light and joy.
marxmas.cta: Discover how we celebrate Christmas at sea.

tourism.text: Los Cabos is an incomparable destination where the desert meets the sea, offering activities for every taste.

sponsorship.heading: Participate as a sponsor
sponsorship.info: Be part of a festival that connects brands with audiences passionate about the sea and Mexican culture.

gallery.heading: Past events gallery
gallery.text: See how we have transformed the sea into a stage of celebration.
